overview.short: Vishnupad Temple in Gaya is an ancient 30-meter black basalt temple enshrining the divine 40-cm footprint of Lord Vishnu, reconstructed by Queen Ahilyabai Holkar in 1787.
overview.description: Standing on the banks of the sacred Falgu River, Vishnupad Temple is the supreme pilgrimage destination for the sacred Hindu rite of Pind Daan. Queen Ahilyabai Holkar of Indore reconstructed the octagonal 100-foot-high temple in 1787 using solid black basalt stone.
features: 1787 Solid Black Basalt Temple by Ahilyabai Holkar
World Epicenter of Ancestral Pind Daan Rites
overview.about: A deeply sacred Vedic pilgrimage complex where ancestral offerings, black basalt carvings, and the subterranean Falgu River evoke timeless devotion.

howToReach.roadNote: Conveniently reached via Grand Trunk Road (NH-19) and NH-22 into Gaya.

topPlaces.name: Vishnupad Sanctum & Ahilyabai Holkar Shikhara
topPlaces.description: 100-foot black basalt temple housing the 40-cm footprint of Lord Vishnu embossed in rock.

topPlaces.name: Akshayavat (The Undying Sacred Banyan Tree)
topPlaces.description: Immortal sacred banyan tree where Goddess Sita performed Pind Daan for King Dasharatha.

topPlaces.name: Falgu River Devghat & Pind Daan Enclave
topPlaces.description: Sacred riverfront ghat where pilgrims offer sacred rice and sesame balls (Pind) to ancestors.

topPlaces.name: Mangla Gauri Temple (Shaktipith of Gaya)
topPlaces.description: Ancient 15th-century hilltop temple recognized as one of the 18 Maha Shakti Peethas.

topPlaces.name: Pretshila Hill & Shraddha Tank (Pretkund)

topPlaces.name: Ramshila Hill & Ancient Shiva Temple
topPlaces.description: Sacred hill where Lord Rama offered Pind Daan, housing ancient Pataleshwar Shiva temples.

topPlaces.name: Gaya Surya Kund & Dakshinarka Sun Temple
